name: Factory Frenzy
desc:
A unique take on the classic tycoon; most similar to Satisfactory, Factorio and other games in that genre! If you enjoy tycoons but find them all to be the same, you will love this game!

⛏️ Mine raw ores deep from the earth!

🏭 Build your own factory to craft valuable resources from the ores!

🚚 Transport your goods to the marketplace and sell them for profit!

Do you have what it takes to master your factory and build the ultimate production empire?
